title: TrustLens URL / Domain Observation
description: Phase 2 WP2 STEP 9. The contract for URL/domain FACTS, without building the future URL-reputation service. It records structural properties a parser can derive (scheme, hostname, registered domain, obfuscation flags) and RESERVES the fields a later intelligence adapter (Phase 6, ADR-0012) will fill — brand match, allowlist, reputation. Those default to UNKNOWN / NOT_EVALUATED and MUST NOT be invented: absence of a reputation service is expressed as NOT_EVALUATED, never as CLEAN and never as MALICIOUS. Whether a URL becomes the LINK_PRESENT / SHORTENED_URL / LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN / FAKE_VERIFICATION_SITE indicator is an indicator-layer decision, not decided here.

raw_url.description: The URL exactly as it appeared in the text.

normalized_url.description: Canonicalised URL (lowercased host, tracking params such as utm_* stripped — matching the Phase-1 source-verification normalisation).

span.description: Where the URL sits in the source text, for traceability.

structural.description: Facts derivable by a PARSER alone. No judgement.

scheme.description: e.g. http, https. Absent if not parseable.

registered_domain.description: eTLD+1, e.g. example.co.in. The unit brand-comparison and allowlisting operate on.

flags.description: Boolean structural properties. Each is a fact, not a verdict. All default false = 'not observed', except where UNKNOWN is meaningful.

shortened.description: Host is a known URL-shortening service, concealing the destination.

obfuscated.description: Contains encoding/obfuscation (percent-encoding of host, @-tricks, excessive subdomains).

ip_literal.description: Host is a raw IP address rather than a domain name.

claimed_brand.description: The brand the surrounding message CLAIMS the link belongs to (e.g. 'Example Bank'), where the text asserts one. A claim, not a verified association.

assessments.description: RESERVED for later intelligence adapters. Every field defaults to the non-committal value. validate_extraction.py enforces that these are never set to a malicious/clean judgement in a WP2 artefact, because no such service exists yet.

domain_matches_claimed_brand.description: Whether registered_domain corresponds to claimed_brand. UNKNOWN until a brand-domain map exists.

allowlist_result.description: Allowlist lookup outcome. NOT_EVALUATED until an allowlist exists. ALLOWLISTED is weak context only (see negative library ALLOWLISTED_DOMAIN_CONTEXT) and never cancels a hard-risk pattern.

reputation_result.description: Threat-intel reputation. NOT_EVALUATED until a reputation adapter (ADR-0012) exists. MALICIOUS/SUSPICIOUS/CLEAN may NOT appear in a WP2 artefact — inventing a reputation result is forbidden.

provenance.description: Which extractor produced these URL facts (typically a PARSER).
